title: Profitable jobs
statement:
You are offered n jobs. Job i runs from time si to time ei and pays pi. You can work on only one job at a time, but a job may start at the exact moment another one ends. Choose jobs to maximise the total pay.
Input: the first line holds n (1 <= n <= 50000). Each of the next n lines holds si ei pi (0 <= si < ei <= 1000000000, 1 <= pi <= 1000000000).
Output: a single integer, the maximum total pay. It can exceed 2^31 but stays below 2^53.
An O(n^2) solution is too slow for the largest tests.

Example
Input:
4
1 3 50
2 4 10
3 5 40
3 6 70
Output:
120
(Take the jobs 1-3 and 3-6.)
